metric_semantics.phase_throughput: Token counts and prompt/generation phase durations supplied by llama.cpp; excludes queueing, model initialization and network/client overhead. SSE event counts are not token counts.
metric_semantics.cold_start_ms: Model/process cold initialization including hash revalidation, inventory, previous-runtime teardown where applicable, and readiness polling. Filesystem caches were not cleared.
metric_semantics.elapsed_ms: Worker runtime wall time including cold initialization and event delivery overhead; excludes coordinator queueing and the full client path.
metric_semantics.client_first_content_ms: Client wall time to the first nonempty choices[].delta.content, including queueing and cold initialization where applicable.
metric_semantics.client_elapsed_ms: Client wall time for the completed SSE request.
metric_semantics.peak_rss_bytes: Runtime-process lifetime high-water RSS from /proc VmHWM, sampled during the request; includes initialization and may include earlier resident-model requests.

limitations: One physical WSL host: process concurrency and request placement were validated, not two-machine scaling or a service-level guarantee.
Benign fixed prompts and generated output are retained solely as explicit demo evidence. Normal inference does not persist prompt or response content.
Completions reached the 64-token limit. This is execution validation, not a model-quality or factual-accuracy benchmark; the sample output contains an imprecise reference to training.
Text generation does not implement the image, vision-review, enhancement, video or 3D backends required to replace Modal in Meld.
The source model was downloaded once with explicit authorization; subsequent demo provisioning copies only local weights, and normal operation has no model downloader.

check_derivations.concurrent_job_intervals_overlap: Computed at source nanosecond precision from coordinator Job.started_at/finished_at: max(started_at) < min(finished_at), independently of overlapping client connection windows.

model_policy.reason: Current operator policy excludes China-origin models and derivatives.
